segments.name: Advanced Safety and User Experience
segments.description: Supplies software, sensors and compute platforms for advanced vehicle safety and user experience.
segments.evidence: Our Advanced Safety and User Experience segment provides advanced software and services, intelligent sensors and high-performance compute platforms; our Engineered Components Group segment provides connection systems, high-performance interconnects, and cable management and protection solutions; and our Electrical Distribution Systems segment provides low voltage and high voltage power, signal and data distribution.

segments.name: Engineered Components Group
segments.description: Makes connectors, interconnects and cable management products for power, signal and data.
segments.evidence: • Engineered Components Group— This segment provides connection systems, high-performance interconnects, and cable management and protection solutions that optimize the distribution of power, signal, and data for next-generation applications across multiple end markets.

segments.name: Electrical Distribution Systems
products: low voltage and high voltage power, signal and data distribution solutions
segments.description: Supplies low and high voltage power, signal and data distribution systems to vehicle makers.
segments.evidence: • Electrical Distribution Systems— This segment provides a full range of low voltage and high voltage power, signal and data distribution solutions needed to deliver fully integrated, cost-optimized architectures.

revenueModel.text: Vehicle manufacturers buy its software, sensors, connectors and electrical architectures.
revenueModel.evidence: We operate 139 major manufacturing facilities and 11 major technical centers utilizing a regional service model that enables us to efficiently and effectively serve our global customers from best cost countries.

changes.text: Realigned into three reportable segments in the first quarter of 2025.
changes.evidence: In connection with the Separation, in the first quarter of 2025, Aptiv realigned its business into three reportable operating segments: Advanced Safety and User Experience, Engineered Components Group and Electrical Distribution Systems.
